canonical_name: Behrend lower-bound construction for three-term-progression-free integer sets
category: 组合数学 / 计数组合
literal_source_claim_zh: 无3项等差数列的大集合
literal_source_claim_en: Large sets without three-term arithmetic progressions.
canonical_statement: For every positive real epsilon, for all sufficiently large natural N, the maximum cardinality of a subset of the nonnegative integers at most N containing no three distinct terms in arithmetic progression is strictly greater than N raised to 1 - (2 * sqrt(2 * log 2) + epsilon) / sqrt(log N).
canonical_claim: For every positive real epsilon, for all sufficiently large natural N, the maximum cardinality of a subset of the nonnegative integers at most N containing no three distinct terms in arithmetic progression is strictly greater than N raised to 1 - (2 * sqrt(2 * log 2) + epsilon) / sqrt(log N).

domain_and_universes: Prop in Lean universe 0; epsilon : Real; N0 N : Nat; real logarithm, square root, and real exponentiation; rothNumberNat (N + 1) : Nat cast to Real; alternate finite sets s : Finset Nat.
quantifiers: every N : Nat satisfying N0 <= N
conclusion: The real rpow lower bound is strictly less than the real cast of rothNumberNat (N + 1), the maximum size of a ThreeAPFree subset of Finset.range (N + 1).
excluded_degenerate_cases: epsilon equal to zero or negative is excluded by 0 < epsilon
no natural N is syntactically excluded; the existential threshold may omit N = 0 and N = 1
degenerate_case_status: N = 0 and N = 1 remain syntactically in the domain but need not exceed the eventual threshold. Constant and repeated triples are allowed as trivial; the checked Nat transport excludes exactly pairwise-distinct progressions. The endpoint N is included through rothNumberNat (N + 1), and the natural extremal cardinality is cast to Real before comparison.
